summary: Three quick, practical tips for better videos, a reality check, then an invitation to get the guide

moments.quote: Here are three tips for better videos.
moments.why: the promise of the reel: this is where viewers decide to stay
she actually enumerates three tips: a list lets viewers keep them

moments.quote: Did you know 80% of creators quit?
moments.why: the proof beat: the number makes the problem real

moments.quote: Comment guide below and follow me for more."
moments.why: the one action she asks for; the keyword is what viewers must type

no_graphics.why: two direct questions to the viewer: let them land on her face, no text competing
'look at this' but there is nothing to point at in this clip: a pointer would be noise

zooms.why: the number lands: punch in on the reveal
slow push on the personal question to draw the viewer in
